audits.objectives: Assess conformity with selected ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A controls, verify operational evidence, identify nonconformities, and track corrective action plans.

findings.title: Weak Password Policy on Legacy Directory
findings.criteria: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.17 & Corporate Authentication Standard v2.1 (minimum 12 characters with complexity).
findings.condition: Current legacy domain GPO allows 8-character passwords and does not enforce special character or breached-password checks.
findings.cause: Legacy service compatibility exception from 2023 was never rolled back after application migration.
findings.impact: Elevated susceptibility to credential stuffing and offline brute-force attacks against domain accounts.
findings.recommendation: Update domain password GPO to enforce a 12-character minimum with complexity and banned-password filtering.

findings.title: Unpatched Software Vulnerabilities on Production Hosts
findings.criteria: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.8.8 & Vulnerability Management Policy (Critical CVEs remediated within 14 days).
findings.condition: Seven production Linux servers are running outdated OpenSSH and kernel packages with Critical CVEs past SLA.
findings.cause: Manual maintenance window approvals delayed automated Ansible patch playbooks during Q3 freeze.
findings.impact: Potential remote code execution or local privilege escalation on internet-adjacent workloads.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated patch management maintenance windows and establish weekly critical CVE SLA tracking.

findings.title: Missing MFA on Cloud Console Admin Accounts
findings.criteria: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.8.5 requiring multi-factor authentication for all privileged administrative access.
findings.condition: Two emergency administrative accounts in the primary cloud tenant did not enforce hardware FIDO2 or TOTP MFA.
findings.cause: Break-glass accounts were excluded from conditional access policy without compensating hardware token enrollment.
findings.impact: Compromise of single-factor credentials could grant full tenant administrative control.
findings.recommendation: Enroll dual FIDO2 hardware security keys for all break-glass and administrative accounts immediately.

findings.title: Unassigned Security Custodians in Cloud Platform Squads
findings.criteria: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Clause 5.3 & Annex A.5.2 (Information security roles and responsibilities).
findings.condition: Three newly created cloud platform squads lacked formally appointed security champions and risk owners.
findings.cause: Q2 engineering reorganization updated HR reporting lines without updating the ISMS RACI register.
findings.impact: Delayed ownership triage for vulnerability and configuration findings in those squads.
findings.recommendation: Update ISMS RACI matrix and issue formal custodian charters for all engineering squads.

findings.title: Delayed Contractor Pre-Employment Screening Completion
findings.criteria: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.6.1 requiring background verification checks prior to system access.
findings.condition: Two short-term contractors received VPN credentials 4 days before background screening clearance arrived.
findings.cause: IAM ticket workflow allowed urgent manager override without CISO sign-off.
findings.impact: Unscreened personnel briefly held internal network access.
findings.recommendation: Enforce hard IAM workflow gate blocking account creation until HR screening status equals Cleared.

findings.title: Broken Root-Account Alert Webhook to On-Call Pager
findings.criteria: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.8.16 & SOC 2 CC7.2 real-time security monitoring requirements.
findings.condition: CloudTrail root-account usage alerts failed delivery due to rotated Pager API key not updated in Terraform secrets.
findings.cause: Absence of automated synthetic heartbeat tests on SIEM notification webhooks.
findings.impact: High-severity cloud privilege events could go unnoticed by on-call responders.
findings.recommendation: Rotate webhook secret in vault and schedule daily synthetic alert delivery health checks.

findings.title: Permissive Pod Security Contexts in Staging Cluster
findings.criteria: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.8.9 & Kubernetes Hardening Baseline.
findings.condition: Two namespaces did not enforce Pod Security Admission restricted profile, allowing privileged containers.
findings.cause: Temporary debugging policy exemption was not auto-expired.
findings.impact: Container escape risk within shared staging cluster.
findings.recommendation: Enforce Kyverno/PSA restricted policy via GitOps across all non-system namespaces.

findings.title: Expired Sub-Processor SOC 2 Attestation
findings.criteria: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.5.19 annual supplier security assurance review.
findings.condition: Annual SOC 2 Type II report on file for analytics vendor expired 45 days prior to review.
findings.cause: Vendor renewal calendar reminders were tied to a departed procurement coordinator.
findings.impact: Unverified control posture at third-party data processor.
findings.recommendation: Obtain renewed SOC 2 Type II report and migrate vendor review alerts to shared GRC queue.

actions.title: Deploy 12-char Fine-Grained Password Policy GPO
actions.corrective_action: Apply updated Default Domain Password Policy requiring 12 characters, complexity, and Azure AD Password Protection.
actions.preventive_action: Add automated nightly CIS Active Directory configuration check in SIEM.
actions.verification_notes: Staged in pilot OU; rollout scheduled for Dec 5.

actions.title: Execute Emergency Linux Kernel & OpenSSH Patch Wave
actions.corrective_action: Patch all 7 production Linux hosts via rolling Ansible playbook and reboot into updated kernel.
actions.preventive_action: Pre-authorize automated monthly critical security patching windows in CAB charter.
actions.verification_notes: 5 of 7 hosts patched and rescanned clean; 2 remaining in cluster B.

actions.title: Bind FIDO2 Hardware Keys to Break-Glass Cloud Admins

actions.preventive_action: Enable IAM Config rule alerting on any admin principal without MFA.
actions.verification_notes: Hardware tokens procured; enrollment ceremony pending CISO witness.
